events.continuity_hook: Closes out the Nashville seminar after flights and the West End suite hotel were chosen, leaving only final local timing and room-routine logistics.
events.interaction_goal: Set the Thursday airport route and hotel arrival plan, map the presenter entrance and garage sequence, decide on a simple food stop or delivery, and confirm Sunday checkout timing against the afternoon flight.
events.scenario_brief: Four days before the Nashville seminar, the West End suite hotel confirms Kara's queen room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, indoor pool, and paid parking, but notes that the garage uses a different entrance after 10 p.m. The hospital sends an updated campus map directing presenters to a rehab staff entrance for the rolling demo bag and asks Kara to finish the Thursday room layout check before security closes the floor at 6:45 p.m. The Thursday nonstop and Sunday afternoon return remain unchanged; the unresolved pieces are the airport-to-hotel transfer, whether to stop for simple groceries before check-in, and the Saturday teardown-to-dinner timing.

events.continuity_hook: Starts a personal recovery weekend after the late-fall work stretch, with hotel comfort carrying more weight than it would on a simple overnight stop.
events.interaction_goal: Build a compact hotel shortlist, weigh walking convenience against the fuller recovery setup, decide whether Friday driving is realistic, and flag the room and parking details to verify before booking.
events.scenario_brief: After the December teaching travel, Kara and her partner pick a February Friday-to-Monday Savannah weekend around his Saturday 10K and two easy walking days. They plan to drive from Tampa, but Friday arrival may be late enough that hotel check-in, parking, and evening food options matter. The main hotel choices split between a riverfront suite property with strong reviews, a queen room, in-room coffee, mini-fridge, indoor pool, hot tub, fitness room, and costly parking; a historic inn closer to the race start with charming rooms but no fitness room or hot tub and unclear fridge availability; and a cheaper Midtown option with a pool and fitness room but no hot tub and a longer morning drive.

events.continuity_hook: Continues the Savannah partner-weekend plan once one practical hotel option becomes bookable and the race timing changes the location trade-off.
events.interaction_goal: Choose whether to reserve the riverfront suite hotel, confirm cancellation and parking terms, set the Friday drive target from Tampa, and make a simple first-night arrival plan.
events.scenario_brief: The riverfront suite hotel opens a cancellable weekend rate for the Savannah dates and confirms the hot tub hours, indoor pool access, fitness room, queen bedding, coffee maker, and mini-fridge. The race organizer moves the Saturday start 30 minutes earlier, making the riverfront location more useful than the cheaper Midtown option. The historic inn can place a small fridge in the room only by request and still lacks the recovery amenities, while the riverfront property's drawbacks are valet-only parking and street work near the arrival route.

events.continuity_hook: Starts the next spring-season teaching episode while the Savannah personal trip is already mostly settled.
events.interaction_goal: Compare the Charlotte flight patterns, weigh the hospital-rate hotel against the more predictable suite setup, and identify what the host must confirm about Thursday access, demo-bag storage, parking, and the Saturday end time.
events.scenario_brief: Kara is asked to teach a late-February Friday-Saturday pediatric tone and gait course at an outpatient hospital facility outside Charlotte. She needs to arrive Thursday with enough time for a classroom layout check, and Saturday debrief could run close to 5 p.m., making a Sunday return more realistic than a Saturday evening flight. Tampa flight choices include a Thursday midday nonstop that protects setup time and a cheaper late connection; return options include a workable Sunday afternoon departure. The closest hospital-rate hotel has uneven recent reviews, run-of-house bedding, and no clear refrigerator details, while a better-rated suite property 12 to 15 minutes away confirms a queen room, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool but no hot tub.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Charlotte course from comparison to booking now that the host has clarified setup and teardown timing.
events.interaction_goal: Book the Thursday outbound and Sunday afternoon return, reserve the suite hotel if the cancellation terms are acceptable, choose the rental car or rideshares, and select a window seat where seat choice is available.
events.scenario_brief: The Charlotte host confirms Thursday classroom access from 3:30 to 6:30 p.m., locked overnight storage for Kara's rolling demo bag, and a Saturday debrief expected to finish by 4:30 p.m. The Thursday midday nonstop is still available and the Sunday afternoon return avoids a rushed Saturday exit. The suite hotel remains the clearest lodging option with confirmed queen bedding, coffee maker, mini-fridge, fitness room, and indoor pool; the hospital-rate hotel still cannot confirm bedding or fridge setup. A compact rental car prices close to projected rideshares and would simplify the hotel-to-clinic commute.

events.continuity_hook: Tightens the Charlotte plan after booking, with a small flight schedule change and final campus access details to absorb before travel.
events.interaction_goal: Confirm whether to keep the retimed Sunday return, set Thursday arrival and Friday-Saturday departure plans, map the staff garage and badge desk route, and make a practical first-night room routine.
events.scenario_brief: About a week before the Charlotte course, the airline shifts Kara's Sunday return 35 minutes earlier, but it still departs in the afternoon. The suite hotel says the indoor pool will open late on the first evening because of maintenance, while the fitness room and in-room amenities remain available. The hospital sends final arrival instructions for a staff garage, a badge desk separate from the main lobby, and an earlier Friday arrival time because the course room is in a different rehab wing than originally listed. The remaining decisions are whether the retimed flight still leaves enough airport buffer, when to leave the hotel each teaching morning, and how to handle simple food after Thursday check-in.
